description: Complete frontend redesign to match the reference photo layout: white/light background, red accents, marketing-style website with navigation bar, hero section, feature cards, how-it-works section, live feed section with integrated analysis panel, and footer. Replace the dark monitoring dashboard with a professional multi-section landing page that integrates the live detection feed.
steps: Rewrite templates/dashboard.html completely with the new structure: (1) Loading screen with logo animation, (2) Navigation bar with logo + 'MATANGLAWIN SEE CRACKS. SAVE LIVES.' tagline + nav links (Home, About, How It Works, Features, Contact as anchor links) + red 'Get Started' button, (3) Hero section with 'Observe. Detect. Protect.' headline, subtitle text about drone crack detection, and a hero image area showing a drone/detection visual with 'CRACK DETECTED' status badge, (4) Features section with cards: 'Crack Observation' and 'Automatic Crack Detection', (5) How It Works section with 3 steps (Observe, Detect, Result) shown as numbered cards, (6) Live Detection section with embedded MJPEG feed from /video_feed and the automatic analysis panel alongside it, (7) Footer with logo, tagline, and copyright. All sections should use anchor IDs for smooth scrolling from nav links.

Rewrite static/style.css completely: white (#ffffff) background, light grays (#f8f9fa, #f0f0f0) for section alternation, red (#d21f1f / #c81e2c) as the primary accent for buttons/highlights/headings, dark text (#1a1a1a, #333, #666) for readability. Use clean sans-serif typography (Inter or system fonts). Sections should have generous padding (80px+ vertical). Navigation should be fixed/sticky at top with white background and subtle shadow. Cards should have rounded corners, subtle shadows, hover effects. The live feed section should be a dark-themed panel (the monitoring area contrasts with the rest of the light page). Make the analysis panel a sidebar or below-feed panel with dark background showing crack classification, severity bars, and measurements. Fully responsive: mobile hamburger menu concept (can be CSS-only), stacked cards on mobile, feed goes full-width on small screens.

Rewrite static/js/dashboard.js completely: (1) Loading screen fade-out on DOMContentLoaded or after timeout, (2) Smooth scroll for nav anchor links, (3) Poll /status every 1 second - update the live indicator dot, the status badge on the hero section, and the alert state, (4) Poll /analysis every 1.5 seconds - update the analysis panel with crack classification, severity percentage bar, estimated dimensions, (5) Camera source selector - POST to /set_source on change, (6) Mobile nav toggle functionality, (7) Alert sound on crack detection rising edge (keep existing pattern). The analysis panel should display each detected crack as a card/row with: type classification, severity as a colored progress bar (green<50%, yellow 50-75%, red>75%), area in pixels, estimated length/width.

Add any placeholder/illustration SVGs needed in static/img/: a drone illustration SVG for the hero section (simple geometric drone silhouette), and step icons for the How It Works section (eye icon for Observe, gear/scan icon for Detect, checkmark/report icon for Result). Keep them minimal and on-brand with the red color.
acceptance_criteria: The page at / serves a complete multi-section website matching the reference layout structure
Navigation bar has logo, tagline, nav links, and Get Started button
Hero section displays 'Observe. Detect. Protect.' headline with visual element
Features section shows at least 2 feature cards
How It Works section shows 3 steps
Live Detection section embeds the /video_feed MJPEG stream
Analysis panel displays crack classification, severity, and measurements from /analysis endpoint
Analysis panel updates automatically via polling (no manual refresh)
Camera source selector is present with IP Camera option (no DroidCam)
Design uses white/light background with red accents throughout
Page is responsive - works on mobile widths (320px+)
Loading screen appears and fades out
Alert sound plays on crack detection rising edge
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/Matanglawin-2.0 && source venv/bin/activate && python -c "from app import app; c=app.test_client(); r=c.get('/'); assert r.status_code==200; html=r.data.decode(); assert 'Observe' in html and 'Detect' in html and 'Protect' in html, 'Missing hero headline'; assert 'How' in html and 'Works' in html, 'Missing how it works section'; assert '/video_feed' in html, 'Missing video feed embed'; assert '/analysis' in html or 'analysis' in html, 'Missing analysis reference'; assert 'IP Camera' in html or 'ip_camera' in html, 'Missing IP Camera option'; assert 'DroidCam' not in html and 'droidcam' not in html, 'DroidCam references remain'"

cd /projects/sandbox/Matanglawin-2.0 && python -c "import os; css=open('static/style.css').read(); assert '#ffffff' in css or '#fff' in css or 'white' in css, 'Missing white background'; assert '#d21f1f' in css or '#c81e2c' in css, 'Missing red accent color'"

cd /projects/sandbox/Matanglawin-2.0 && python -c "js=open('static/js/dashboard.js').read(); assert '/status' in js, 'Missing status polling'; assert '/analysis' in js, 'Missing analysis polling'; assert 'set_source' in js, 'Missing source selector'"
